data.body: Root cause recorded in the description (2026-11-21 PST). Evidence: JUnit tracebacks from run 44681457334 per test; CRLF hypothesis for the 3 shellcheck tests reproduced on macOS (a CRLF ok.sh gives shellcheck rc 1, SC1017 on every line); the delta-tree fallback test compares str(Path) (backslashes on Windows) with git ls-tree names. Design evaluated: adopted the distlib ScriptMaker .exe stub, because the _run_in_group seam precedent covers only in-process git and cannot reach the child-process stubs in metrics_polyglot_support.py and test_repo_isolation_guard.py, and a .cmd shim is not found by CreateProcess. distlib 0.3.6 (the lowest-direct floor) checked to build and run a stub under Python 3.13. Investigation run: tmp/w3-pangolin at d8b1aec2633, dispatch run 44894685390.
